question: Are the remaining active-check families (SQLi, reflected/stored XSS & DOM, open redirect, header injection, SSTI, OS command, LDAP, code injection, SMTP, server-level, external interaction, header manipulation) implemented with Burp's actual payloads, detection logic and confirmation steps, or only matched to Burp by family name?
probes: Remaining, non-timing: Collaborator everywhere (Zc7h); PHP code injection Collaborator half (Zxvv.ZQ fsockopen/gethostbyname); the in-band 'Out-of-band resource load (HTTP)' path of Zsrh; insertion points not built yet: entire body (Zuq.ZT), nested base64/JSON-in-param (Zuq.Zq), XML standalone tags (Zuq.Za), parameter names (Zuq.Zp), moved parameters (off by default); skip_server_side_injection_for_parameters tagging (PHPSESSID, jsessionid, ...).

Stored XSS retrieval is limited to safe GETs (base GET, same-origin redirect target, up to 3 crawled GETs); Burp pairs any later request whose response showed the stored input. Live parity against Burp not run (Burp comparison scans are out of bounds for this task).
Excluded by the safety stop: the timing engine burp.Zwj_ and its families (time-based SQLi, OS command, server-side JavaScript, code injection timing).
evidence_for: Wave 31d showed the traversal and XXE probes were name-only: different payloads, no negative control, no baseline suppression, and an XXE entity that was never referenced.
evidence_against: Traversal, XXE and CSRF are now ported from burp.Zp3a/Zscp/Zw_c/Zge7 and burp.Zg8u/Zg8w.

2026-11-16: ported from source and verified on the live lab (21/21 issues identical with Burp scan 5): SQL injection error-based + boolean (Zppj), reflected XSS (Zi6p context engine), SSTI, open redirection (Zuag), header injection (Zwi), LDAP (Zwkf), SSI (Zexx), XXE, traversal, link manipulation (Zb_5), input returned (Zr02), SMTP (fnd_48).

2026-11-16: HTTP TRACE method (Zs6x, fnd_83) and the error-based half of XML injection (Zp7s, fnd_84) ported with tests; OOB interactions now raise Burp's 'External service interaction (DNS)/(HTTP)' issues instead of a WebProbe-only name.

2026-11-16 (D-03, fnd_85): insertion points follow burp.Zuq.Zs order and the Zwez cap: URL/body/multipart/JSON params, cookies (skip-listed _ga/_gid/_gat/_ga_*/_gac_*/AWSALB* dropped), X-* headers, User-Agent, Referer (synthesised https://example.com/ when absent), URL path folders, URL path filename; one cap of 30 over accepted points. scan.rs insertion_points/inject; tests insertion_points_follow_burp_order_and_cap, query_/cookie_/header_/multipart_/url_path_folder_and_filename_insertion_points. Reflected XSS severity per point kind (Zwwb.Zv).

2026-11-16 (D-02): ported with positive and negative unit tests in active_checks.rs: PHP code injection echo-based on file-upload parts (fnd_86), Cross-site scripting (stored) as Burp's breakout engine over injection + safe GET retrieval (fnd_87; also verified end to end on 127.0.0.1 by active_scan_finds_stored_xss_and_cookie_xss_on_a_local_server), Client-side template injection (fnd_88), XML injection Collaborator half with Ze_f/Zbiw payloads registered as 'XML injection' on DNS interaction (fnd_89).
